meta_description: Fresh Landscapes Liverpool — bespoke garden design and landscaping. Transform your outdoor space with creative, sustainable design. Call for a free consultation.
hero_subhead: Expert garden design and landscaping for Liverpool homes. From initial concept through to planting and hardscaping, we create gardens you'll love for years.
services_heading: Complete Garden Design & Landscaping Across Liverpool
services_subhead: From concept drawings to finished landscapes, we handle every aspect of your garden transformation with creativity and care.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke designs tailored to your space, style, and budget. We create detailed plans and 3D visualisations so you can see your garden before we break ground.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping
services.desc: Professionally laid patios, decking, and pathways using quality materials. We design outdoor living areas that extend your home and withstand Liverpool's weather.

services.title: Planting & Soft Landscaping
services.desc: Thoughtful plant selection, borders, and shrub design for year-round colour and structure. We choose plants suited to your soil and light conditions.

services.title: Garden Maintenance Plans
services.desc: Ongoing care packages to keep your new garden thriving. Regular pruning, feeding, and seasonal maintenance mean less work for you.

services.title: Water Features & Lighting
services.desc: Ponds, fountains, and garden lighting transform your space day and night. We integrate these elements seamlessly into your overall design.

services.title: Raised Beds & Vegetable Gardens
services.desc: Productive kitchen gardens and raised planting beds for growing your own veg and herbs. Ideal for busy Liverpool households.

about_pullquote: Every garden tells a story. We make sure yours tells the right one.
about_para_1: Fresh Landscapes was founded twelve years ago with a simple idea: that every Liverpool home deserves an outdoor space that reflects the owner's personality and lifestyle. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a respected design practice, completing over 180 gardens across Merseyside. We combine artistic vision with practical horticultural knowledge — every design is informed by on-site surveys, soil analysis, and detailed understanding of how our clients actually use their gardens.
about_para_2: Our reputation rests on listening carefully to what you want, then delivering something even better. We manage every project from conception through to completion, sourcing quality materials, coordinating contractors, and handling all the logistics so you don't have to. Repeat clients and word-of-mouth referrals make up the bulk of our work — that's the trust we've earned by showing up on time, respecting budgets, and never cutting corners.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Fresh Landscapes

reviews.text: We had no idea what to do with our overgrown back garden. Mark came round, listened to what we actually wanted, and delivered something completely different but ten times better. The design is stunning, the workmanship is immaculate, and he cleaned up after himself every single day. Genuinely the best tradespeople experience we've had. Can't recommend enough.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Had a small patio and some tired borders. Fresh Landscapes redesigned the whole thing with raised beds, new plants, and a decked seating area. It's transformed how we use the garden. Very professional throughout, and they explained everything they were doing. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Brilliant from start to finish. The design process was thorough but not complicated, and the team built everything to a really high standard. We've had loads of compliments from neighbours. If you're thinking about getting your garden done, use Fresh Landscapes.
reviews.author: Rebecca T.
